kim: Quick heads-up — PR #8301 (scheduler-compact-fix) is blocking tonight's cut. We need 2x LGTM before the 23:00 UTC cutoff or it will be auto-backed out. Can people on rotation pick this up? @andre @sasha
andre: I'm jumping on it now. CI shows unit tests ✅ but integration has one flaky failure.
sasha: I can do a second pass in ~20m. note: suspicious change in slot calc around scheduler::compact(), might be an off-by-one.
kim: thanks. deploy-bot: merge-queue status: PR 8301 — unit: pass, integration: flaky (1/3 retries) :warning:
andre: left two small comments and a suggested test tweak. nothing blocking.
sasha: pushed a tiny fixture adjustment to stabilize the integration test, re-running CI: `./scripts/ci rerun 8301`
deploy-bot: CI rerun queued for PR 8301 — estimated time ~8m
zoe: If sasha signs off, I can be standby for the merge and cutover at 23:00 UTC.
maria: I'm on-call tonight, will watch the smoke and be ready to rollback if needed.
kim: operational plan: need both LGTM by 22:45 UTC to give 15m for smoke. fallback: auto-backout scheduled at 23:05 UTC if not 2 approvals. assigning standby: @zoe (merge), @maria (rollback). please ack.
zoe: ack :+1:
maria: ack :eyes:
andre: LGTM — approving on GitHub now.
sasha: LGTM — test tweak fixed the flake for me. approving.
kim: excellent, leaving a short note on the PR outlining rollback steps and the autobackout window.
deploy-bot: PR 8301 merged at 22:37 UTC by @zoe — smoke job started.
zoe: smoke passed, metrics look normal. I'll monitor traces for +15m.
maria: all good on my side, cancelling rollback standby. nice work team :tada:
